title: The Ten Plagues Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Ten Plagues Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Ten Plagues Bible crossword: the river turned to blood, frogs, lice, hail, locusts and the darkness that could be felt. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Ten refusals and ten answers, escalating each time: a river turned to blood, frogs in the kneadingtroughs, lice, flies, murrain, boils, hail mingled with fire, locusts, and a darkness over Egypt that could be felt. The Ten Plagues puts them in a grid in order.
The clues use the KJV's own names for them, several of which are worth meeting — murrain, blains, kneadingtroughs. The closing verse is the LORD's word to Moses before the last plague of all.
